newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 1,000 head were exported to the United States at two crossing points Tuesday.
Through Nogales, Ariz., around 800 head were sold at mostly steady prices for steer calves. "Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices for 300-400 lb feeder steers were between 76 and 85 cents a lb and for 400-500 lb head they were between 68 and 75 cents a lb.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 200 head were sold, but not enough to establish trend or quotes prices. Supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500lbs," USDA said.
